common.purpose: Resolve what remains open in the Can editor refresh: where spanless checker messages land, which names go-to-definition resolves, and what happens to buffers the project loader cannot see.
fixed_constraints: The rewrite keeps the transport loop and version tracking and replaces all predecessor-AST, proof, baseline, lint, and coverage semantics with one inert bridge over the current pipeline. No editor request may build, run, assert, dial out, query, read the environment, emit files, or mutate registries.

Coded span diagnostics flow from lexing and parsing; resolve and check contribute plain first-failure strings on both CLI and LSP. Matching the CLI means echoing that first message, positioned exactly when spans exist and filed honestly otherwise.

UTF-16 positions come from the shared source logic, identity from canonical paths, and each version publishes a complete replacement set whenever text, presence, or imports change. Old spellings, externs, and proof gates are gone from every surface.

Declarations already expose nominal identities with source spans including generated question shapes, and grammar plus gramcheck now cover current syntax alone with legacy patterns and checks retired.

check_error_anchor.facts: Unpositioned checker text may mention paths or names but never offsets. Filing it at the file's first line preserves the message without pretending at tokens, while guessing a token from the text manufactures precision the pipeline never had.

navigation_depth.facts: Resolution walks the scopes visible to the file toward declaration spans. Locals live in per-body scopes outside that walk, so serving them demands parallel scope reconstruction at the cursor.

unsaved_new_file.facts: The loader either walks a buffer's path or it does not. Holding novel buffers silent until save guarantees CLI agreement; virtualizing them into the graph offers early but potentially contradictory answers.

check_error_anchor.instructions: Select the landing place for spanless checker messages. Use common and topics.check_error_anchor.

criteria.file_line_anchor: File the identical message on line 1 of the attributed or open file. Token-exact ranges stay exclusive to spanned diagnostics.
criteria.heuristic_token: Guess a token from the message text and underline the match. Manufactured precision misfires on every ambiguous name.
criteria.review_needed: This evidence leaves the anchors indistinguishable, or neither upholds the contracts.

navigation_depth.instructions: Select which names definition jumps resolve. Use common and topics.navigation_depth.

criteria.file_scope_symbols: Serve jumps for scope-visible nominals, functions, constructors, and generated declarations and decline the rest. Each answer is a resolved declaration identity.
criteria.scope_aware_locals: Serve locals too by reconstructing body scopes at the cursor. Coverage widens with dedicated scope machinery.
criteria.review_needed: This evidence leaves the depths indistinguishable, or neither upholds the contracts.

unsaved_new_file.instructions: Select the fate of buffers the loader cannot see. Use common and topics.unsaved_new_file.

criteria.ignore_until_saved: Keep novel buffers empty of diagnostics until save puts them in the load. CLI agreement holds by construction.
criteria.virtual_source: Admit novel buffers as virtual sources and diagnose immediately. Early coverage can contradict the CLI.
criteria.review_needed: This evidence leaves the treatments indistinguishable, or neither upholds the contracts.
